{{Quote|For the next course, a rack of toasted Febrini sand-prestors with a subtle gangini sauce.|434-FPC|<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''Febrini sand-prestor''' was a type of creature<ref name="Galladinium" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Febrini system/Legends|Febrini system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[434-FPC Personal Chef Droid]] [[434-FPC]] [[Chef/Legends|prepared]] a [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] for several people. Following the initial course consisting of [[caramaxoian salad]] with [[Dihneral herb-and-ale dressing]], the [[Cooking droid/Legends|droid]] planned to serve a rack of toasted Febrini sand-prestors paired with [[gangini sauce]] that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] characterized as "subtle."<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Febrini sand-prestor was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
